table: ASTER spectral library rows (directional hemispherical reflectance, percent, against wavelength in micrometres) cited by the IR proxy's emissivity classes
primary_source: https://speclib.jpl.nasa.gov (the ASTER Spectral Library version 2.0, now within the ECOSTRESS spectral library)
primary_citation: Baldridge, A. M., Hook, S. J., Grove, C. I. and Rivera, G. (2009). The ASTER spectral library version 2.0. Remote Sensing of Environment 113, 711-715; Meerdink, S. K. et al. (2019). The ECOSTRESS spectral library version 1.0. Remote Sensing of Environment 230, 111196
primary_note: speclib.jpl.nasa.gov answered 403 through this container's proxy (2026-09-29); the rows were fetched from the two GitHub mirrors named per file, bytes unchanged, and are not compared with the primary here
transform: none: every file is the mirror's bytes as fetched (the snow row keeps its CRLF line ends); the emissivity is formed in code as 1 - R/100 (Kirchhoff, an opaque sample) and Planck-weighted over the band
licence: ASTER / ECOSTRESS spectral library data, courtesy of NASA/JPL-Caltech; cite the primary references above
